# Deterministic natural keys for derived entities

Certain entity types use deterministic natural keys: project uses project/{slugify(repo_slug)}, pull_request uses pull-request/{number}, component uses component/{slugify(path)}, api uses api/{slugify(method route)}, test_coverage uses test-coverage/{slugify(node_id)}, and wiki_page uses wiki-page/{slugify(owner_slug)}.

Ensure stable, reproducible slugs for entities derived from immutable or canonical identifiers so identity is consistent across runs.
